noun_data.noun_definition: A data copy is a duplicate of an original data structure that maintains the same values and organization.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, a data copy is created using `cloneDeep` to ensure that the original data structure remains unchanged while transformations are applied to its contents.

noun_data.noun_definition: A clipboard copy action is the process of duplicating selected content to the system clipboard for later use.
noun_data.noun_summary: The function sets up a keyboard shortcut for the clipboard copy action, allowing users to copy selected content to the clipboard when the specified shortcut is pressed.

noun_data.noun_definition: Sign in hero copy is the textual content displayed prominently on a sign-in interface to guide and inform users.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the sign in hero copy consists of a customizable headline and body text that can either be provided by the user or default to translated strings, ensuring that the sign-in interface communicates effectively with users.

noun_data.noun_definition: Clipboard copy is the action of duplicating data to the system clipboard for later retrieval.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the clipboard copy functionality allows users to copy the card number (PAN) to the clipboard when they press the associated button, facilitating easy pasting of the card number elsewhere.
